description:
Hey everyone! I am a Artificial Intelligence student . I love building practical tools using Python, FastAPI, vector search, and local machine learning pipelines. For NASA Space Apps, our goal is to turn open space and Earth observations into an intuitive, functional web tool.

Why join us? We plan early, ship a solid working prototype quickly, and avoid last-minute stress.

We need teammates for: • Frontend development and clean UI design • Data or space exploration

Let us team up and win!
